identityLayers.rule: E Host Binding references a verified GraphDigestV2 and does not redefine or append fields to its canonical input.

rows.transform: accept only a host registry value bound to repository, commit, rootTree and sourceDigest
rows.failure: unavailable when registry is missing, caller-supplied, or mismatched
rows.notes: Do not promote the path-derived value to trusted identity.

rows.transform: reuse digest computed from the immutable tracked-file byte snapshot
rows.evidence: digestTrackedTree uses sorted tracked relative paths and exact bytes
rows.failure: unavailable when any bound file bytes or checkout tree changes

rows.transform: strict field-preserving conversion to GraphNode; UTF-8 canonical sorting by id
rows.evidence: SourceNode fields and kind enum in model.ts
rows.failure: rejected on unknown field, invalid path/offset, unsupported kind, or duplicate id

rows.transform: strict field-preserving conversion to GraphEdge; preserve certainty, sourceUse, selectorScope and mediaContext
rows.evidence: Relation fields and enum in model.ts/project.ts
rows.failure: rejected on unknown field, unknown endpoint, invalid sourceUse, duplicate relation id, or conflicting payload

rows.transform: preserve strings, reject duplicates, sort by UTF-8 bytes only for canonicalization
rows.evidence: project.ts returns a de-duplicated unresolved list
rows.failure: rejected on non-string or duplicate member; never delete to obtain a digest

rows.transform: candidate mapping only when the node is anchored by one source-proven file→token-use reads edge and exact byte checks pass
rows.evidence: project.ts emits token-use location.path/offset and byteOffset from parseCssTokenSource
rows.failure: mapping omitted and GraphDigest unavailable when anchor or byte proof is missing

rows.transform: require unique relation id, file source path, token-use endpoint, and sourceUse equality plus byte-span verification
rows.failure: mapping rejected/unavailable on missing, duplicate, or conflicting anchor

rows.transform: use the exact token-use graph node id for sourceRef; never derive it from relation id or label
rows.evidence: PR72 SourceGraph has no SourceNode.sourceRef field
rows.failure: unavailable when an exact graph node cannot be identified

rows.transform: exclude from the ten fields; retain in external evidence/host records
rows.failure: no digest input change; host record is unavailable if required evidence is absent

rows.transform: preserve only explicit values; do not infer producer or source identity from prefixes, endpoints, or certainty
rows.evidence: PR72 relations do not consistently carry these fields
rows.failure: producer provenance remains unavailable when occurrence evidence is missing
